By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: output
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction out or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedAnnotation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedConjugator
inheritedAttributes.documentation: A Conjugation owned by this Type for which the Type is the originalType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDifferencing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Differencings, having this Type as their typeDifferenced.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDisjoining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Disjoinings, for which the Type is the typeDisjoined Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements owned by this Element, derived as the ownedRelatedElements of the ownedRelationships of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedEndFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All endFeatures of this Type that are ownedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the ownedFeatureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships, for which the Type is the owningType. Each such FeatureMembership identifies an ownedFeature of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedImport
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Imports, for which the Namespace is the importOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedIntersecting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Intersectings, have the Type as their typeIntersected.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMember
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owned members of this Namespace, which are the <cpde>ownedMemberElements of the ownedMemberships of the Namespace.</cpde>

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Memberships, for which the Namespace is the membershipOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSpecialization
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Specializations, for which the Type is the specific Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedUnioning
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Unionings, having the Type as their typeUnioned.

inheritedAttributes.name: owner
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owner of this Element, derived as the owningRelatedElement of the owningRelationship of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owningRelationship of this Element, if that Relationship is a Membership.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningNamespace
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Namespace that owns this Element, which is the membershipOwningNamespace of the owningMembership of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationship for which this Element is an ownedRelatedElement, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

constraints.name: checkFeatureCrossingSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If this Feature has isEnd = true and ownedCrossFeature returns a non-null value, then the crossFeature of the Feature must be the Feature returned from ownedCrossFeature (which implies that this Feature has an appropriate ownedCrossSubsetting to realize this).

constraints.name: checkFeatureDataValueSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has an ownedTyping relationship to a DataType, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Base::dataValues from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: checkFeatureEndRedefinition
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has isEnd = true and an owningType that is not empty, then, for each direct supertype of its owningType, it must redefine the endFeature at the same position, if any.
constraints.ocl:
isEnd and owningType <> null implies
    let i : Integer = 
        owningType.ownedEndFeature->indexOf(self) in
    owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->
        forAll(supertype |
             supertype.endFeature->size() >= i implies
                redefines(supertype.endFeature->at(i))

constraints.name: checkFeatureEndSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has isEnd = true and an owningType that is an Association or a Connector, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Links::Link::participant from the Kernel Semantic Library.
constraints.ocl:
isEnd and owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Association) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Connector)) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Links::Link::participant')

constraints.name: checkFeatureFeatureMembershipTypeFeaturing
constraints.documentation: If a Feature is owned via a FeatureMembership, then it must have a featuringType for which the operation isFeaturingType returns true.

constraints.name: checkFeatureFlowFeatureRedefinition
constraints.documentation: If a Feature is the first ownedFeature of a first or second FlowEnd, then it must directly or indirectly specialize either Transfers::Transfer::source::sourceOutput or Transfers::Transfer::target::targetInput, respectively, from the Kernel Semantic Library.
constraints.ocl:
owningType <> null and
owningType.oclIsKindOf(FlowEnd) and
owningType.ownedFeature->at(1) = self implies
    let flowType : Type = owningType.owningType in
    flowType <> null implies
        let i : Integer = 
            flowType.ownedFeature.indexOf(owningType) in
        (i = 1 implies 
            redefinesFromLibrary('Transfers::Transfer::source::sourceOutput')) and
        (i = 2 implies
            redefinesFromLibrary('Transfers::Transfer::target::targetInput'))

constraints.name: checkFeatureObjectSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has an ownedTyping relationship to a Structure, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Objects::objects from the Kernel Semantics Library.

constraints.name: checkFeatureOccurrenceSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has an ownedTyping relationship to a Class, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Occurrences::occurrences from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureRedefinitionSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If this Feature is the ownedCrossFeature of an end Feature, then, for any end Feature that is redefined by the owning end Feature of this Feature, this Feature must subset the crossFeature of the redefined end Feature, if this exists.

constraints.name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If this Feature is the ownedCrossFeature of an end Feature, then it must directly or indirectly specialize the types of its owning end Feature.

constraints.name: checkFeatureOwnedCrossFeatureTypeFeaturing
constraints.documentation: If this Feature is the ownedCrossFeature of an end Feature, then it must have featuringTypes consistent with the crossing from other end Features of the owningType of its end Feature.
constraints.ocl:
isOwnedCrossFeature() implies
    let otherEnds : OrderedSet(Feature) = 
        owner.oclAsType(Feature).owningType.endFeature->excluding(self) in
    if (otherEnds->size() = 1) then
        featuringType = otherEnds->first().type
    else
        featuringType->size() = 1 and
        featuringType->first().isCartesianProduct() and
        featuringType->first().asCartesianProduct() = otherEnds.type and
        featuringType->first().allSupertypes()->includesAll(
            owner.oclAsType(Feature).ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->
               select(crossFeature() <> null).crossFeature().featuringType)      
    endif

constraints.name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
constraints.documentation:
If a Feature is a parameter of an owningType that is a Behavior or Step, but not
  • A result parameter
  • A parameter of an InvocationExpression, with at least one non-implied ownedRedefinition
then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Behavior or Step, it must redefine the parameter at the same position, if any.
constraints.ocl:
owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and
    (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies
        not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied)))
implies
    let ownerParameters : Sequence(Feature) =
        owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->
            reject(owningFeatureMembership.
                oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in
    ownerParameters->includes(self) implies
        let i : Integer = ownerParameters.indexof(self) in
        owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->
            forAll(supertype |
                supertype.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or 
                    supertype.oclIsKindOf(Step) 
                implies
                    let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =
                        supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->
                            reject(owningFeatureMembership.
                                oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in
                    ownedParameters->size() >= i implies
                        redefines(ownedParameters->at(i)))

constraints.name: checkFeaturePortionSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has isPortion = true, an ownedTyping relationship to a Class, and an owningType that is a Class or another Feature typed by a Class, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Occurrences::Occurrence::portions from the Kernel Semantic Library.
constraints.ocl:
isPortion and
ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Class)) and
owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Class) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and
    owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->
        exists(oclIsKindOf(Class))) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::portions')

constraints.name: checkFeatureResultRedefinition
constraints.documentation: If a Feature is a result parameter of an owningType that is a Function or Expression, then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Function or Expression, it must redefine the result parameter.
constraints.ocl:
owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) and
    self = owningType.oclAsType(Function).result or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and
    self = owningType.oclAsType(Expression).result) implies
    owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->
        select(oclIsKindOf(Function) or oclIsKindOf(Expression))->
        forAll(supertype |
            redefines(
                if superType.oclIsKindOf(Function) then
                    superType.oclAsType(Function).result
                else
                    superType.oclAsType(Expression).result
                endif)

constraints.name: checkFeatureSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A Feature must directly or indirectly specialize Base::things from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: checkFeatureSubobjectSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A composite Feature typed by a Structure, and whose ownedType is a Structure or another Feature typed by a Structure must directly or indirectly specialize Objects::Object::subobjects.
constraints.ocl:
isComposite and
ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Structure)) and
owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Structure) or
 owningType.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Structure))) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::suboccurrences')

constraints.name: checkFeatureSuboccurrenceSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A composite Feature that has an ownedTyping relationship to a Class, and whose ownedType is a Class or another Feature typed by a Class, must directly or indirectly specialize Occurrences::Occurrence::suboccurrences.
constraints.ocl:
isComposite and
ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Class)) and
owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Class) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and
    owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->
        exists(oclIsKindOf(Class))) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::suboccurrences')

constraints.name: checkFeatureValuationSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has a FeatureValue, no ownedSpecializations that are not implied, and is not directed, then it must specialize the result of the value Expression of the FeatureValue.
constraints.ocl:
direction = null and
ownedSpecializations->forAll(isImplied) implies
    ownedMembership->
        selectByKind(FeatureValue)->
        forAll(fv | specializes(fv.value.result))

constraints.name: deriveFeatureChainingFeature
constraints.documentation: The chainingFeatures of a Feature are the chainingFeatures of its ownedFeatureChainings.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureCrossFeature
constraints.documentation: The crossFeature of a Feature is the second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of the Feature, if any.
constraints.ocl:
crossFeature =
    if ownedCrossSubsetting = null then null
    else 
        let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = 
            ownedCrossSubsetting.crossedFeature.chainingFeature in
        if chainingFeatures->size() < 2 then null
        else chainingFeatures->at(2)
    endif

constraints.name: deriveFeatureFeatureTarget
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has no chainingFeatures, then its featureTarget is the Feature itself, otherwise the featureTarget is the last of the chainingFeatures.
constraints.ocl: featureTarget = if chainingFeature->isEmpty() then self else chainingFeature->last() endif

constraints.name: deriveFeatureFeaturingType
constraints.documentation: The featuringTypes of a Feature include the featuringTypes of all the typeFeaturings of the Feature. If the Feature has chainingFeatures, then its featuringTypes also include the featuringTypes of the first chainingFeature.
constraints.ocl:
featuringType =
    let featuringTypes : OrderedSet(Type) = 
        typeFeaturing.type->asOrderedSet() in
    if chainingFeature->isEmpty() then featuringTypes
    else
        featuringTypes->
            union(chainingFeature->first().featuringType)->
            asOrderedSet()
    endif

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
constraints.documentation: The ownedCrossSubsetting of a Feature is the ownedSubsetting that is a CrossSubsetting, if any.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedFeatureChaining
constraints.documentation: The ownedFeatureChainings of a Feature are the ownedRelationships that are FeatureChainings.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedFeatureInverting
constraints.documentation: The ownedFeatureInvertings of a Feature are its ownedRelationships that are FeatureInvertings.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedRedefinition
constraints.documentation: The ownedRedefinitions of a Feature are its ownedSubsettings that are Redefinitions.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting
constraints.documentation: The ownedReferenceSubsetting of a Feature is the firstownedSubsetting that is a ReferenceSubsetting (if any).
constraints.ocl:
ownedReferenceSubsetting =
    let referenceSubsettings : OrderedSet(ReferenceSubsetting) =
        ownedSubsetting->selectByKind(ReferenceSubsetting) in
    if referenceSubsettings->isEmpty() then null
    else referenceSubsettings->first() endif

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedSubsetting
constraints.documentation: The ownedSubsettings of a Feature are its ownedSpecializations that are Subsettings.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedTypeFeaturing
constraints.documentation: The ownedTypeFeaturings of a Feature are its ownedRelationships that are TypeFeaturings and which have the Feature as their featureOfType.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureOwnedTyping
constraints.documentation: The ownedTypings of a Feature are its ownedSpecializations that are FeatureTypings.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureType
constraints.documentation: The types of a Feature are the union of the types of its typings and the types of the Features it subsets, with all redundant supertypes removed. If the Feature has chainingFeatures, then the union also includes the types of the last chainingFeature.
constraints.ocl:
type = 
    let types : OrderedSet(Types) = OrderedSet{self}->
        -- Note: The closure operation automatically handles circular relationships.
        closure(typingFeatures()).typing.type->asOrderedSet() in
    types->reject(t1 | types->exist(t2 | t2 <> t1 and t2.specializes(t1)))

constraints.name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance
constraints.documentation: Each chainingFeature (other than the first) must be featured within the previous chainingFeature.

constraints.name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureNotOne
constraints.documentation: A Feature must have either no chainingFeatures or more than one.

constraints.name: validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf
constraints.documentation: A Feature cannot be one of its own chainingFeatures.

constraints.name: validateFeatureConstantIsVariable
constraints.documentation: A Feature with isConstant = true must have isVariable = true.

constraints.name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If this Feature has a crossFeature, then, for any Feature that is redefined by this Feature, the crossFeature must specialize the crossFeature of the redefined end Feature, if this exists.
constraints.ocl:
crossFeature <> null implies
    ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature.crossFeature->
            forAll(f | f <> null implies crossFeature.specializes(f))

constraints.name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureType
constraints.documentation: The crossFeature of a Feature must have the same types as the Feature.

constraints.name: validateFeatureEndIsConstant
constraints.documentation: A Feature with isEnd = true and isVariable = true must have isConstant = true.

constraints.name: validateFeatureEndMultiplicity
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has isEnd = true, then it must have multiplicity 1..1.

constraints.name: validateFeatureEndNoDirection
constraints.documentation: A Feature with isEnd = true must have no direction.

constraints.name: validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion
constraints.documentation: A Feature with isEnd = true must have all of isDerived = false, isAbstract = false, isComposite = false, and isPortion = false.
constraints.ocl: isEnd implies not (isDerived or isAbstract or isComposite or isPortion)

constraints.name: validateFeatureIsVariable
constraints.documentation: A Feature with isVariable = true must have an owningType that directly or indirectly specializes the Class Occurrences::Occurrence from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain
constraints.documentation: If a Feature has a multiplicity, then the featuringTypes of the multiplicity must be the same as those of the Feature itself.

constraints.name: validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
constraints.documentation: A Feature must have at most one ownedSubsetting that is a CrossSubsetting.

constraints.name: validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting
constraints.documentation: A Feature must have at most one ownedSubsetting that is an ReferenceSubsetting.

classes.name: FeatureChainExpression
classes.documentation: A FeatureChainExpression is an OperatorExpression whose operator is ".", which resolves to the Function ControlFunctions::'.' from the Kernel Functions Library. It evaluates to the result of chaining the result Feature of its single argument Expression with its targetFeature.
classes.summary: A FeatureChainExpression is an OperatorExpression whose operator is ".", which resolves to the Function ControlFunctions::'.' from the Kernel Functions Library.

ownedAttributes.name: targetFeature
ownedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that is accessed by this FeatureChainExpression, which is its first non-parameter member.

inheritedAttributes.name: aliasIds
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Various alternative identifiers for this Element. Generally, these will be set by tools.

inheritedAttributes.name: argument
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Expressions whose results are bound to features of the instantiatedType. The arguments are ordered consistent with the order of the features, though they may not be one-to-one with all the features.Note. The derivation of argument is given in the concrete subclasses of InstantiationExpression.

inheritedAttributes.name: behavior
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that type this Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: chainingFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: crossFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of this Feature, if it has one. Semantically, the values of the crossFeature of an end Feature must include all values of the end Feature obtained when navigating from values of the other end Features of the same owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The declared name of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An optional alternative name for the Element that is intended to be shorter or in some way more succinct than its primary name. It may act as a modeler-specified identifier for the Element, though it is then the responsibility of the modeler to maintain the uniqueness of this identifier within a model or relative to some other context.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: directedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The features of this Type that have a non-null direction.

inheritedAttributes.name: direction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates how values of this Feature are determined or used (as specified for the FeatureDirectionKind).

inheritedAttributes.name: documentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Documentation owned by this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: elementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The globally unique identifier for this Element. This is intended to be set by tooling, and it must not change during the lifetime of the Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: endFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features of this Type with isEnd = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: endOwningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is related to this Feature by an EndFeatureMembership in which the Feature is an ownedMemberFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: feature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the featureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: featureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMemberships for features of this Type, which include all ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships (but does not include any importedMemberships).

inheritedAttributes.name: featureTarget
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: function
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Function that types this Expression.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: instantiatedType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is being instantiated.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isModelLevelEvaluable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Expression meets the constraints necessary to be evaluated at model level, that is, using metadata within the model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

inheritedAttributes.name: name
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: output
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction out or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedAnnotation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedConjugator
inheritedAttributes.documentation: A Conjugation owned by this Type for which the Type is the originalType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedCrossSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a CrossSubsetting}, for which the Feature is the crossingFeature.

constraints.name: checkFeatureChainExpressionResultSpecialization
constraints.documentation: The result parameter of a FeatureChainExpression must specialize the feature chain of the FeatureChainExpression.
constraints.ocl:
let inputParameters : Sequence(Feature) = 
    ownedFeatures->select(direction = _'in') in
let sourceTargetFeature : Feature = 
    owningExpression.sourceTargetFeature() in
sourceTargetFeature <> null and
result.subsetsChain(inputParameters->first(), sourceTargetFeature) and
result.owningType = self

constraints.name: checkFeatureChainExpressionSourceTargetRedefinition
constraints.documentation: The first ownedFeature of the first owned input parameter of a FeatureChainExpression must redefine its targetFeature.
constraints.ocl:
let sourceTargetFeature : Feature = sourceTargetFeature() in
sourceTargetFeature <> null and
sourceTargetFeature.redefines(targetFeature)

constraints.name: checkFeatureChainExpressionTargetRedefinition
constraints.documentation: The first ownedFeature of the first owned input parameter of a FeatureChainExpression must redefine the Feature ControlFunctions::'.'::source::target from the Kernel Functions Library.
constraints.ocl:
let sourceTargetFeature : Feature = sourceTargetFeature() in
sourceTargetFeature <> null and
sourceTargetFeature.redefinesFromLibrary('ControlFunctions::\'.\'::source::target')

constraints.name: deriveFeatureChainExpressionTargetFeature
constraints.documentation: The targetFeature of a FeatureChainExpression is the memberElement of its first ownedMembership that is not a ParameterMembership.
constraints.ocl:
targetFeature =
    let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->
        reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in
    if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or
       not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)
    then null
    else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)
    endif

constraints.name: validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance
constraints.documentation: The targetFeature of a FeatureChainExpression must be featured within the result parameter of the argument Expression of the FeatureChainExpression.

constraints.name: validateFeatureChainExpressionOperator
constraints.documentation: The operator of a FeatureChainExpression must be ".".

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isModelLevelEvaluable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Expression meets the constraints necessary to be evaluated at model level, that is, using metadata within the model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

constraints.name: checkFeatureReferenceExpressionBindingConnector
constraints.documentation: A FeatureReferenceExpression must have an ownedMember that is a BindingConnector between the referent and result of the FeatureReferenceExpression.

constraints.name: checkFeatureReferenceExpressionResultSpecialization
constraints.documentation: The result parameter of a FeatureReferenceExpression must specialize the referent of the FeatureReferenceExpression.

constraints.name: deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent
constraints.documentation: The referent of a FeatureReferenceExpression is the memberElement of its first ownedMembership that is not a ParameterMembership.
constraints.ocl:
referent =
    let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->
        reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in
    if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or
       not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)
    then null
    else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)
    endif

constraints.name: validateFeatureReferenceExpressionReferentIsFeature
constraints.documentation: The first ownedMembership of a FeatureReferenceExpression that is not a ParameterMembership must have a Feature as its memberElement.
constraints.ocl:
let membership : Membership = 
    ownedMembership->reject(m | m.oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in
membership->notEmpty() and
membership->at(1).memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)

constraints.name: validateFeatureReferenceExpressionResult
constraints.documentation: A FeatureReferenceExpression must own its result parameter.

classes.name: FeatureTyping
classes.documentation: FeatureTyping is Specialization in which the specific Type is a Feature. This means the set of instances of the (specific) typedFeature is a subset of the set of instances of the (general) type. In the simplest case, the type is a Classifier, whereupon the typedFeature has values that are instances of the Classifier.

classes.name: FeatureValue
classes.documentation: A FeatureValue is a Membership that identifies a particular member Expression that provides the value of the Feature that owns the FeatureValue. The value is specified as either a bound value or an initial value, and as either a concrete or default value. A Feature can have at most one FeatureValue.The result of the value Expression is bound to the featureWithValue using a BindingConnector. If isInitial = false, then the featuringType of the BindingConnector is the same as the featuringType of the featureWithValue. If isInitial = true, then the featuringType of the BindingConnector is restricted to its startShot.If isDefault = false, then the above semantics of the FeatureValue are realized for the given featureWithValue. Otherwise, the semantics are realized for any individual of the featuringType of the featureWithValue, unless another value is explicitly given for the featureWithValue for that individual.
classes.summary: A FeatureValue is a Membership that identifies a particular member Expression that provides the value of the Feature that owns the FeatureValue.

constraints.name: checkFeatureValueBindingConnector
constraints.documentation: If isDefault = false, then the featureWithValue must have an ownedMember that is a BindingConnector whose relatedElements are the featureWithValue and a feature chain consisting of the value Expression and its result. If isInitial = false, then this BindingConnector must have featuringTypes that are the same as those of the featureWithValue. If isInitial = true, then the BindingConnector must have that.startShot as its featuringType.
constraints.ocl:
not isDefault implies
    featureWithValue.ownedMember->
        selectByKind(BindingConnector)->exists(b |
            b.relatedFeature->includes(featureWithValue) and
            b.relatedFeature->exists(f | 
                f.chainingFeature = Sequence{value, value.result}) and
            if not isInitial then 
                b.featuringType = featureWithValue.featuringType
            else 
                b.featuringType->exists(t |
                    t.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and
                    t.oclAsType(Feature).chainingFeature =
                        Sequence{
                            resolveGlobal('Base::things::that').
                                memberElement,
                            resolveGlobal('Occurrences::Occurrence::startShot').
                                memberElement
                        }
                )
            endif)

constraints.name: validateFeatureValueOverriding

classes.documentation: An Flow is a Step that represents the transfer of values from one Feature to another. Flows can take non-zero time to complete.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImplied
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Relationship was generated by tooling to meet semantic rules, rather than being directly created by a modeler.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

constraints.name: checkFlowSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A Flow must directly or indirectly specialize the Step Transfers::transfers from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: checkFlowWithEndsSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A Flow with ownedEndFeatures must specialize the Step Transfers::flowTransfers from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: deriveFlowFlowEnd
constraints.documentation: The flowEnds of a Flow are all its connectorEnds that are FlowEnds.

constraints.name: deriveFlowPayloadFeature
constraints.documentation: The payloadFeature of a Flow is the single one of its ownedFeatures that is a PayloadFeature.

constraints.name: deriveFlowPayloadType
constraints.documentation: The payloadTypes of a Flow are the types of the payloadFeature of the Flow (if any).
constraints.ocl:
payloadType =
    if payloadFeature = null then Sequence{}
    else payloadFeature.type
    endif

constraints.name: deriveFlowSourceOutputFeature
constraints.documentation: The sourceOutputFeature of a Flow is the first ownedFeature of the first connectorEnd of the Flow.
constraints.ocl:
sourceOutputFeature =
    if connectorEnd->isEmpty() or 
        connectorEnd.ownedFeature->isEmpty()
    then null
    else connectorEnd.ownedFeature->first()
    endif

constraints.name: deriveFlowTargetInputFeature
constraints.documentation: The targetInputFeature of a Flow is the first ownedFeature of the second connectorEnd of the Flow.
constraints.ocl:
targetInputFeature =
    if connectorEnd->size() < 2 or 
        connectorEnd->at(2).ownedFeature->isEmpty()
    then null
    else connectorEnd->at(2).ownedFeature->first()
    endif

constraints.name: validateFlowPayloadFeature
constraints.documentation: A Flow must have at most one ownedFeature that is an PayloadFeature.

For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

classes.name: FlowEnd
classes.documentation: A FlowEnd is a Feature that is one of the connectorEnds giving the source or target of a Flow. For Flows typed by FlowTransfer or its specializations, FlowEnds must have exactly one ownedFeature, which redefines Transfer::source::sourceOutput or Transfer::target::targetInput and redefines the corresponding feature of the relatedElement for its end.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType

Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelationship

inheritedAttributes.name: parameter
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The parameters of this Step, which are defined as its directedFeatures, whose values are passed into and/or out of a performance of the Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: payloadFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedFeature of the Flow that is a PayloadFeature (if any).

inheritedAttributes.name: payloadType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The type of values transferred, which is the type of the payloadFeature of the Flow.

inheritedAttributes.name: portionKind
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The kind of temporal portion (time slice or snapshot) is represented by this OccurrenceUsage. If portionKind is not null, then the owningType of the OccurrenceUsage must be non-null, and the OccurrenceUsage represents portions of the featuring instance of the owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: relatedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements that are related by this Relationship, derived as the union of the source and target Elements of the Relationship.

inheritedAttributes.name: relatedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Features that are related by this Connector considered as a Relationship and that restrict the links it identifies, given by the referenced Features of the connectorEnds of the Connector.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: source
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElements from which this Relationship is considered to be directed.

inheritedAttributes.name: sourceFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The source relatedFeature for this Connector. It is the first relatedFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: sourceOutputFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that provides the items carried by the Flow. It must be a feature of the source of the Flow.

inheritedAttributes.name: target
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElements to which this Relationship is considered to be directed.

inheritedAttributes.name: targetFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The target relatedFeatures for this Connector. This includes all the relatedFeatures other than the sourceFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: targetInputFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that receives the values carried by the Flow. It must be a feature of the target of the Flow.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: type
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that restrict the values of this Feature, such that the values must be instances of all the types. The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

inheritedAttributes.name: usage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are features of this Usage (not necessarily owned).

inheritedAttributes.name: variant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages which represent the variants of this Usage as a variation point Usage, if isVariation = true. If isVariation = false, then there must be no variants.

inheritedAttributes.name: variantMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Usage that are VariantMemberships. If isVariation = true, then this must be all memberships of the Usage. If isVariation = false, then variantMembershipmust be empty.

constraints.name: checkFlowUsageFlowSpecialization
constraints.documentation: If a FlowUsage has ownedEndFeatures, it must directly or indirectly specialize the FlowUsage Flows::flows from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: checkFlowUsageSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A FlowUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the base FlowUsage Flows::messages from the Systems Library model.

classes.name: ForLoopActionUsage
classes.documentation: A ForLoopActionUsage is a LoopActionUsage that specifies that its bodyAction ActionUsage should be performed once for each value, in order, from the sequence of values obtained as the result of the seqArgument Expression, with the loopVariable set to the value for each iteration.
classes.summary: A ForLoopActionUsage is a LoopActionUsage that specifies that its bodyAction ActionUsage should be performed once for each value, in order, from the sequence of…

ownedAttributes.name: loopVariable
ownedAttributes.documentation: The ownedFeature of this <co>ForLoopActionUsage that acts as the loop variable, which is assigned the successive values of the input sequence on each iteration. It is the ownedFeature that redefines ForLoopAction::var.</co>

ownedAttributes.name: seqArgument
ownedAttributes.documentation: The Expression whose result provides the sequence of values to which the loopVariable is set for each iterative performance of the bodyAction. It is the Expression whose result is bound to the seq input parameter of this ForLoopActionUsage.

inheritedAttributes.name: actionDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that are the types of this ActionUsage. Nominally, these would be ActionDefinitions, but other kinds of Kernel Behaviors are also allowed, to permit use of Behaviors from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: aliasIds
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Various alternative identifiers for this Element. Generally, these will be set by tools.

inheritedAttributes.name: behavior
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that type this Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: bodyAction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsage to be performed repeatedly by the LoopActionUsage. It is the second parameter of the LoopActionUsage.

inheritedAttributes.name: chainingFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: crossFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of this Feature, if it has one. Semantically, the values of the crossFeature of an end Feature must include all values of the end Feature obtained when navigating from values of the other end Features of the same owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The declared name of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An optional alternative name for the Element that is intended to be shorter or in some way more succinct than its primary name. It may act as a modeler-specified identifier for the Element, though it is then the responsibility of the modeler to maintain the uniqueness of this identifier within a model or relative to some other context.

inheritedAttributes.name: definition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Classifiers that are the types of this Usage. Nominally, these are Definitions, but other kinds of Kernel Classifiers are also allowed, to permit use of Classifiers from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: directedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The features of this Type that have a non-null direction.

inheritedAttributes.name: directedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The usages of this Usage that are directedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: direction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates how values of this Feature are determined or used (as specified for the FeatureDirectionKind).

inheritedAttributes.name: documentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Documentation owned by this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: elementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The globally unique identifier for this Element. This is intended to be set by tooling, and it must not change during the lifetime of the Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: endFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features of this Type with isEnd = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: endOwningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is related to this Feature by an EndFeatureMembership in which the Feature is an ownedMemberFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: feature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the featureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: featureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMemberships for features of this Type, which include all ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships (but does not include any importedMemberships).

inheritedAttributes.name: featureTarget
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: individualDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The at most one occurrenceDefinition that has isIndividual = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isIndividual
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this OccurrenceUsage represents the usage of the specific individual represented by its individualDefinition.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isReference
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is a referential Usage, that is, it has isComposite = false.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is for a variation point or not. If true, then all the memberships of the Usage must be VariantMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: mayTimeVary
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage may be time varying (that is, whether it is featured by the snapshots of its owningType, rather than being featured by the owningType itself). However, if isConstant is also true, then the value of the Usage is nevertheless constant over the entire duration of an instance of its owningType (that is, it has the same value on all snapshots).The property mayTimeVary redefines the KerML property Feature::isVariable, making it derived. The property isConstant is inherited from Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

inheritedAttributes.name: name
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The AllocationUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The OccurrenceUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The StateUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TransitionUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are ownedFeatures of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The UseCaseUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Classes that are the types of this OccurrenceUsage. Nominally, these are OccurrenceDefinitions, but other kinds of kernel Classes are also allowed, to permit use of Classes from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureInverting

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSpecialization
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Specializations, for which the Type is the specific Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSubsetting

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTypeFeaturing
