ownedAttributes.name: payloadArgument
ownedAttributes.documentation: An Expression whose result is bound to the payload input parameter of this SendActionUsage.

ownedAttributes.name: receiverArgument
ownedAttributes.documentation: An Expression whose result is bound to the receiver input parameter of this SendActionUsage.

ownedAttributes.name: senderArgument
ownedAttributes.documentation: An Expression whose result is bound to the sender input parameter of this SendActionUsage.

inheritedAttributes.name: actionDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that are the types of this ActionUsage. Nominally, these would be ActionDefinitions, but other kinds of Kernel Behaviors are also allowed, to permit use of Behaviors from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: aliasIds
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Various alternative identifiers for this Element. Generally, these will be set by tools.

inheritedAttributes.name: behavior
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that type this Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: chainingFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: crossFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of this Feature, if it has one. Semantically, the values of the crossFeature of an end Feature must include all values of the end Feature obtained when navigating from values of the other end Features of the same owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The declared name of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An optional alternative name for the Element that is intended to be shorter or in some way more succinct than its primary name. It may act as a modeler-specified identifier for the Element, though it is then the responsibility of the modeler to maintain the uniqueness of this identifier within a model or relative to some other context.

inheritedAttributes.name: definition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Classifiers that are the types of this Usage. Nominally, these are Definitions, but other kinds of Kernel Classifiers are also allowed, to permit use of Classifiers from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: directedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The features of this Type that have a non-null direction.

inheritedAttributes.name: directedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The usages of this Usage that are directedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: direction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates how values of this Feature are determined or used (as specified for the FeatureDirectionKind).

inheritedAttributes.name: documentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Documentation owned by this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: elementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The globally unique identifier for this Element. This is intended to be set by tooling, and it must not change during the lifetime of the Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: endFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features of this Type with isEnd = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: endOwningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is related to this Feature by an EndFeatureMembership in which the Feature is an ownedMemberFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: feature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the featureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: featureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMemberships for features of this Type, which include all ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships (but does not include any importedMemberships).

inheritedAttributes.name: featureTarget
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: individualDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The at most one occurrenceDefinition that has isIndividual = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isIndividual
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this OccurrenceUsage represents the usage of the specific individual represented by its individualDefinition.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isReference
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is a referential Usage, that is, it has isComposite = false.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is for a variation point or not. If true, then all the memberships of the Usage must be VariantMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: mayTimeVary
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage may be time varying (that is, whether it is featured by the snapshots of its owningType, rather than being featured by the owningType itself). However, if isConstant is also true, then the value of the Usage is nevertheless constant over the entire duration of an instance of its owningType (that is, it has the same value on all snapshots).The property mayTimeVary redefines the KerML property Feature::isVariable, making it derived. The property isConstant is inherited from Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

inheritedAttributes.name: name
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedAction

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The StateUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TransitionUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are ownedFeatures of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedVerificationCase

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ViewpointUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction out or inout.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedConjugator

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a CrossSubsetting}, for which the Feature is the crossingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDifferencing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Differencings, having this Type as their typeDifferenced.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDisjoining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Disjoinings, for which the Type is the typeDisjoined Type.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements owned by this Element, derived as the ownedRelatedElements of the ownedRelationships of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedEndFeature

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureChaining

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureInverting

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedIntersecting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Intersectings, have the Type as their typeIntersected.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Memberships, for which the Namespace is the membershipOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRedefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSubsettings of this Feature that are Redefinitions, for which the Feature is the redefiningFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedReferenceSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a ReferenceSubsetting, for which the Feature is the referencingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSpecialization
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Specializations, for which the Type is the specific Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSpecializations of this Feature that are Subsettings, for which the Feature is the subsettingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTypeFeaturing

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Unionings, having the Type as their typeUnioned.

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMembership that owns this Feature as an ownedMemberFeature, determining its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is the owningType of the owningFeatureMembership of this Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningUsage

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The parameters of this Step, which are defined as its directedFeatures, whose values are passed into and/or out of a performance of the Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: portionKind
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The kind of temporal portion (time slice or snapshot) is represented by this OccurrenceUsage. If portionKind is not null, then the owningType of the OccurrenceUsage must be non-null, and the OccurrenceUsage represents portions of the featuring instance of the owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: type
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that restrict the values of this Feature, such that the values must be instances of all the types. The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

inheritedAttributes.name: usage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are features of this Usage (not necessarily owned).

inheritedAttributes.name: variant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages which represent the variants of this Usage as a variation point Usage, if isVariation = true. If isVariation = false, then there must be no variants.

inheritedAttributes.name: variantMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Usage that are VariantMemberships. If isVariation = true, then this must be all memberships of the Usage. If isVariation = false, then variantMembershipmust be empty.

constraints.name: checkSendActionUsageSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A SendActionUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the ActionUsage Actions::sendActions from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: checkSendActionUsageSubactionSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A composite SendActionUsage that is a subaction must directly or indirectly specialize the ActionUsage Actions::Action::sendSubactions from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: deriveSendActionUsagePayloadArgument
constraints.documentation: The payloadArgument of a SendActionUsage is its first argument Expression.

constraints.name: deriveSendActionUsageReceiverArgument
constraints.documentation: The receiverArgument of a SendActionUsage is its third argument Expression.

constraints.name: deriveSendActionUsageSenderArgument
constraints.documentation: The senderArgument of a SendActionUsage is its second argument Expression.

constraints.name: validateSendActionUsagePayloadArgument
constraints.documentation: If a SendActionUsage is owned via a StateSubactionMembership or a TransitionFeatureMembership, then it must have a payloadArgument.
constraints.ocl:
owningFeatureMembership <> null and
(owningFeatureMembership.oclIsKindOf(StateSubactionMembership) or
 owningFeatureMembership.oclIsKindOf(TransitionFeatureMembership)) implies
    payloadArgument <> null

classes.name: Specialization
classes.documentation: Specialization is a Relationship between two Types that requires all instances of the specific type to also be instances of the general Type (i.e., the set of instances of the specific Type is a subset of those of the general Type, which might be the same set).

constraints.name: deriveStateDefinitionDoAction
constraints.documentation: The doAction of a StateDefinition is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = do.
constraints.ocl:
doAction =
    let doMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::do) in
    if doMemberships->isEmpty() then null
    else doMemberships->at(1)
    endif

constraints.name: deriveStateDefinitionEntryAction
constraints.documentation: The entryAction of a StateDefinition is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = entry.
constraints.ocl:
entryAction =
    let entryMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::entry) in
    if entryMemberships->isEmpty() then null
    else entryMemberships->at(1)
    endif

constraints.name: deriveStateDefinitionExitAction
constraints.documentation: The exitAction of a StateDefinition is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = exit.
constraints.ocl:
exitAction = 
    let exitMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::exit) in
    if exitMemberships->isEmpty() then null

    endif

inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedAnnotation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements owned by this Element, derived as the ownedRelatedElements of the ownedRelationships of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMemberElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Element that becomes an ownedMember of the membershipOwningNamespace due to this OwningMembership.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMemberElementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The elementId of the ownedMemberElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMemberFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that this FeatureMembership relates to its owningType, making it an ownedFeature of the owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMemberName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name of the ownedMemberElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMemberShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The shortName of the ownedMemberElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelatedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElements of this Relationship that are owned by the Relationship.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: owner
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owner of this Element, derived as the owningRelatedElement of the owningRelationship of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owningRelationship of this Element, if that Relationship is a Membership.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningNamespace
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Namespace that owns this Element, which is the membershipOwningNamespace of the owningMembership of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelatedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElement of this Relationship that owns the Relationship, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationship for which this Element is an ownedRelatedElement, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that owns this FeatureMembership.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: relatedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements that are related by this Relationship, derived as the union of the source and target Elements of the Relationship.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: source
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElements from which this Relationship is considered to be directed.

inheritedAttributes.name: target
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The relatedElements to which this Relationship is considered to be directed.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: visibility
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not the Membership of the memberElement in the membershipOwningNamespace is publicly visible outside that Namespace.

constraints.name: validateStateSubactionMembershipOwningType
constraints.documentation: The owningType of a StateSubactionMembership must be a StateDefinition or a StateUsage.

classes.name: StateUsage
classes.documentation: A StateUsage is an ActionUsage that is nominally the Usage of a StateDefinition. However, other kinds of kernel Behaviors are also allowed as types, to permit use of BehaviorsA StateUsage may be related to up to three of its ownedFeatures by StateSubactionMembership Relationships, all of different kinds, corresponding to the entry, do and exit actions of the StateUsage.
classes.summary: A StateUsage is an ActionUsage that is nominally the Usage of a StateDefinition.

ownedAttributes.name: doAction
ownedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsage of this StateUsage to be performed while in the state defined by the StateDefinition. It is the owned ActionUsage related to the StateUsage by a StateSubactionMembership with kind = do.

ownedAttributes.name: entryAction
ownedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsage of this StateUsage to be performed on entry to the state defined by the StateDefinition. It is the owned ActionUsage related to the StateUsage by a StateSubactionMembership with kind = entry.

ownedAttributes.name: exitAction
ownedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsage of this StateUsage to be performed on exit to the state defined by the StateDefinition. It is the owned ActionUsage related to the StateUsage by a StateSubactionMembership with kind = exit.

ownedAttributes.name: isParallel
ownedAttributes.documentation: Whether the nestedStates of this StateUsage are to all be performed in parallel. If true, none of the nestedActions (which include nestedStates) may have any incoming or outgoing Transitions. If false, only one nestedState may be performed at a time.

ownedAttributes.name: stateDefinition
ownedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that are the types of this StateUsage. Nominally, these would be StateDefinitions, but kernel Behaviors are also allowed, to permit use of Behaviors from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: actionDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that are the types of this ActionUsage. Nominally, these would be ActionDefinitions, but other kinds of Kernel Behaviors are also allowed, to permit use of Behaviors from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: aliasIds
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Various alternative identifiers for this Element. Generally, these will be set by tools.

inheritedAttributes.name: behavior
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that type this Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: chainingFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: crossFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of this Feature, if it has one. Semantically, the values of the crossFeature of an end Feature must include all values of the end Feature obtained when navigating from values of the other end Features of the same owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The declared name of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An optional alternative name for the Element that is intended to be shorter or in some way more succinct than its primary name. It may act as a modeler-specified identifier for the Element, though it is then the responsibility of the modeler to maintain the uniqueness of this identifier within a model or relative to some other context.

inheritedAttributes.name: definition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Classifiers that are the types of this Usage. Nominally, these are Definitions, but other kinds of Kernel Classifiers are also allowed, to permit use of Classifiers from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: directedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The features of this Type that have a non-null direction.

inheritedAttributes.name: directedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The usages of this Usage that are directedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: direction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates how values of this Feature are determined or used (as specified for the FeatureDirectionKind).

inheritedAttributes.name: documentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Documentation owned by this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: elementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The globally unique identifier for this Element. This is intended to be set by tooling, and it must not change during the lifetime of the Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: endFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features of this Type with isEnd = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: endOwningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is related to this Feature by an EndFeatureMembership in which the Feature is an ownedMemberFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: feature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the featureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: featureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMemberships for features of this Type, which include all ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships (but does not include any importedMemberships).

inheritedAttributes.name: featureTarget
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: individualDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The at most one occurrenceDefinition that has isIndividual = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isIndividual
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this OccurrenceUsage represents the usage of the specific individual represented by its individualDefinition.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isReference
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is a referential Usage, that is, it has isComposite = false.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage is for a variation point or not. If true, then all the memberships of the Usage must be VariantMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: mayTimeVary
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Usage may be time varying (that is, whether it is featured by the snapshots of its owningType, rather than being featured by the owningType itself). However, if isConstant is also true, then the value of the Usage is nevertheless constant over the entire duration of an instance of its owningType (that is, it has the same value on all snapshots).The property mayTimeVary redefines the KerML property Feature::isVariable, making it derived. The property isConstant is inherited from Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

inheritedAttributes.name: name
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedAction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ActionUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedAllocation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The AllocationUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedAnalysisCase
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The AnalysisCaseUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedAttribute
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The code>AttributeUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedCalculation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The CalculationUsage that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedCase
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The CaseUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedConcern
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ConcernUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedConnection
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ConnectorAsUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage. Note that this list includes BindingConnectorAsUsages, SuccessionAsUsages, and FlowUsages because these are ConnectorAsUsages even though they are not ConnectionUsages.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedConstraint
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ConstraintUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedEnumeration
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The code>EnumerationUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedFlow
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The code>FlowUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedInterface
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The InterfaceUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedItem
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ItemUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedMetadata
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The MetadataUsages that are ownedMembers of this of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedOccurrence
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The OccurrenceUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedPart
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The PartUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedPort
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The PortUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedReference
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ReferenceUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedRendering
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The RenderingUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedRequirement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The RequirementUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedState
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The StateUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedTransition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TransitionUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are ownedFeatures of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedUseCase
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The UseCaseUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedVerificationCase
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The VerificationCaseUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedView
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ViewUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: nestedViewpoint
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ViewpointUsages that are nestedUsages of this Usage.

inheritedAttributes.name: occurrenceDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Classes that are the types of this OccurrenceUsage. Nominally, these are OccurrenceDefinitions, but other kinds of kernel Classes are also allowed, to permit use of Classes from the Kernel Model Libraries.

inheritedAttributes.name: output
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction out or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedAnnotation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedConjugator
inheritedAttributes.documentation: A Conjugation owned by this Type for which the Type is the originalType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedCrossSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a CrossSubsetting}, for which the Feature is the crossingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDifferencing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Differencings, having this Type as their typeDifferenced.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDisjoining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Disjoinings, for which the Type is the typeDisjoined Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements owned by this Element, derived as the ownedRelatedElements of the ownedRelationships of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedEndFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All endFeatures of this Type that are ownedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the ownedFeatureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureChaining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are FeatureChainings, for which the Feature will be the featureChained.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureInverting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are FeatureInvertings and for which the Feature is the featureInverted.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships, for which the Type is the owningType. Each such FeatureMembership identifies an ownedFeature of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedImport
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Imports, for which the Namespace is the importOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedIntersecting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Intersectings, have the Type as their typeIntersected.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMember
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owned members of this Namespace, which are the <cpde>ownedMemberElements of the ownedMemberships of the Namespace.</cpde>

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Memberships, for which the Namespace is the membershipOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRedefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSubsettings of this Feature that are Redefinitions, for which the Feature is the redefiningFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedReferenceSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a ReferenceSubsetting, for which the Feature is the referencingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSpecialization
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Specializations, for which the Type is the specific Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSpecializations of this Feature that are Subsettings, for which the Feature is the subsettingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTypeFeaturing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are TypeFeaturings and for which the Feature is the featureOfType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTyping
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSpecializations of this Feature that are FeatureTypings, for which the Feature is the typedFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedUnioning
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Unionings, having the Type as their typeUnioned.

inheritedAttributes.name: owner
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owner of this Element, derived as the owningRelatedElement of the owningRelationship of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningDefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Definition that owns this Usage (if any).

inheritedAttributes.name: owningFeatureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMembership that owns this Feature as an ownedMemberFeature, determining its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owningRelationship of this Element, if that Relationship is a Membership.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningNamespace
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Namespace that owns this Element, which is the membershipOwningNamespace of the owningMembership of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationship for which this Element is an ownedRelatedElement, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is the owningType of the owningFeatureMembership of this Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningUsage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usage in which this Usage is nested (if any).

inheritedAttributes.name: parameter
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The parameters of this Step, which are defined as its directedFeatures, whose values are passed into and/or out of a performance of the Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: portionKind
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The kind of temporal portion (time slice or snapshot) is represented by this OccurrenceUsage. If portionKind is not null, then the owningType of the OccurrenceUsage must be non-null, and the OccurrenceUsage represents portions of the featuring instance of the owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: type
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that restrict the values of this Feature, such that the values must be instances of all the types. The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

inheritedAttributes.name: usage
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages that are features of this Usage (not necessarily owned).

inheritedAttributes.name: variant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Usages which represent the variants of this Usage as a variation point Usage, if isVariation = true. If isVariation = false, then there must be no variants.

inheritedAttributes.name: variantMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Usage that are VariantMemberships. If isVariation = true, then this must be all memberships of the Usage. If isVariation = false, then variantMembershipmust be empty.

constraints.name: checkStateUsageExclusiveStateSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A StateUsage that is a substate usage with a non-parallel owning StateDefinition or StateUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the StateUsage States::StateAction::exclusiveStates from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: checkStateUsageOwnedStateSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A composite StateUsage whose owningType is a PartDefinition or PartUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the StateUsage Parts::Part::ownedStates from the Systems Model Library.
constraints.ocl:
isComposite and owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(PartDefinition) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(PartUsage)) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Parts::Part::ownedStates')

constraints.name: checkStateUsageSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A StateUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the StateUsage States::stateActions from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: checkStateUsageSubstateSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A StateUsage that is a substate usage with a owning StateDefinition or StateUsage that is parallel must directly or indirectly specialize the StateUsage States::StateAction::substates from the Systems Model Library.

constraints.name: deriveStateUsageDoAction
constraints.documentation: The doAction of a StateUsage is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = do.
constraints.ocl:
doAction =
    let doMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::do) in
    if doMemberships->isEmpty() then null
    else doMemberships->at(1)
    endif

constraints.name: deriveStateUsageEntryAction
constraints.documentation: The entryAction of a StateUsage is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = entry.
constraints.ocl:
entryAction =
    let entryMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::entry) in
    if entryMemberships->isEmpty() then null
    else entryMemberships->at(1)
    endif

constraints.name: deriveStateUsageExitAction
constraints.documentation: The exitAction of a StateUsage is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = exit.
constraints.ocl:
exitAction =
    let exitMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =
        ownedMembership->
            selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->
            select(kind = StateSubactionKind::exit) in
    if exitMemberships->isEmpty() then null
    else exitMemberships->at(1)
    endif

constraints.name: validateStateUsageParallelSubactions
constraints.documentation: If a StateUsage is parallel, then its nestedActions (which includes nestedStates) must not have any incomingTransitions or outgoingTransitions.

constraints.name: validateStateUsageStateSubactionKind
constraints.documentation: A StateUsage must not have more than one owned StateSubactionMembership of each kind.

classes.name: Step
classes.documentation: A Step is a Feature that is typed by one or more Behaviors. Steps may be used by one Behavior to coordinate the performance of other Behaviors, supporting a steady refinement of behavioral descriptions. Steps can be ordered in time and can be connected using Flows to specify things flowing between their parameters.
classes.summary: A Step is a Feature that is typed by one or more Behaviors.

ownedAttributes.name: behavior
ownedAttributes.documentation: The Behaviors that type this Step.

ownedAttributes.name: parameter
ownedAttributes.documentation: The parameters of this Step, which are defined as its directedFeatures, whose values are passed into and/or out of a performance of the Step.

inheritedAttributes.name: aliasIds
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Various alternative identifiers for this Element. Generally, these will be set by tools.

inheritedAttributes.name: chainingFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Feature that are chained together to determine the values of this Feature, derived from the chainingFeatures of the ownedFeatureChainings of this Feature, in the same order. The values of a Feature with chainingFeatures are the same as values of the last Feature in the chain, which can be found by starting with the values of the first Feature (for each instance of the domain of the original Feature), then using each of those as domain instances to find the values of the second Feature in chainingFeatures, and so on, to values of the last Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: crossFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The second chainingFeature of the crossedFeature of the ownedCrossSubsetting of this Feature, if it has one. Semantically, the values of the crossFeature of an end Feature must include all values of the end Feature obtained when navigating from values of the other end Features of the same owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The declared name of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: declaredShortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An optional alternative name for the Element that is intended to be shorter or in some way more succinct than its primary name. It may act as a modeler-specified identifier for the Element, though it is then the responsibility of the modeler to maintain the uniqueness of this identifier within a model or relative to some other context.

inheritedAttributes.name: differencingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with differencingTypes are asserted to be those of the first of those Types, but not including those of the remaining Types. For example, a Classifier might be the difference of a Classifier for people and another for people of a particular nationality, leaving people who are not of that nationality. Similarly, a feature of people might be the difference between a feature for their children and a Classifier for people of a particular sex, identifying their children not of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: directedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The features of this Type that have a non-null direction.

inheritedAttributes.name: direction
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates how values of this Feature are determined or used (as specified for the FeatureDirectionKind).

inheritedAttributes.name: documentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Documentation owned by this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: elementId
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The globally unique identifier for this Element. This is intended to be set by tooling, and it must not change during the lifetime of the Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: endFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features of this Type with isEnd = true.

inheritedAttributes.name: endOwningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is related to this Feature by an EndFeatureMembership in which the Feature is an ownedMemberFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: feature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the featureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: featureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMemberships for features of this Type, which include all ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships (but does not include any importedMemberships).

inheritedAttributes.name: featureTarget
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The last of the chainingFeatures of this Feature, if it has any. Otherwise, this Feature itself.

inheritedAttributes.name: featuringType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that feature this Feature, such that any instance in the domain of the Feature must be classified by all of these Types, including at least all the featuringTypes of its typeFeaturings. If the Feature is chained, then the featuringTypes of the first Feature in the chain are also featuringTypes of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: importedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Memberships in this Namespace that result from the ownedImports of this Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All the memberFeatures of the inheritedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: inheritedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships inherited by this Type via Specialization or Conjugation. These are included in the derived union for the memberships of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: input
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction in or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: intersectingType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with intersectingTypes are asserted to be those in common among the intersectingTypes, which are the Types derived from the intersectingType of the ownedIntersectings of this Type. For example, a Classifier might be an intersection of Classifiers for people of a particular sex and of a particular nationality. Similarly, a feature for people's children of a particular sex might be the intersection of a Feature for their children and a Classifier for people of that sex (because the interpretations of the children Feature that identify those of that sex are also interpretations of the Classifier for that sex).

inheritedAttributes.name: isAbstract
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether instances of this Type must also be instances of at least one of its specialized Types.

inheritedAttributes.name: isComposite
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the Feature is a composite feature of its featuringType. If so, the values of the Feature cannot exist after its featuring instance no longer does and cannot be values of another composite feature that is not on the same featuring instance.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConjugated
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Indicates whether this Type has an ownedConjugator.

inheritedAttributes.name: isConstant
inheritedAttributes.documentation: If isVariable is true, then whether the value of this Feature nevertheless does not change over all snapshots of its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: isDerived
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature can always be computed from the values of other Features.

inheritedAttributes.name: isEnd
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not this Feature is an end Feature. An end Feature always has multiplicity 1, mapping each of its domain instances to a single co-domain instance. However, it may have a crossFeature, in which case values of the crossFeature must be the same as those found by navigation across instances of the owningType from values of other end Features to values of this Feature. If the owningType has n end Features, then the multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness declared for the crossFeature of any one of these end Features constrains the cardinality, ordering, and uniqueness of the collection of values of that Feature reached by navigation when the values of the other n-1 end Features are held fixed.

inheritedAttributes.name: isImpliedIncluded
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all necessary implied Relationships have been included in the ownedRelationships of this Element. This property may be true, even if there are not actually any ownedRelationships with isImplied = true, meaning that no such Relationships are actually implied for this Element. However, if it is false, then ownedRelationships may not contain any implied Relationships. That is, either all required implied Relationships must be included, or none of them.

inheritedAttributes.name: isLibraryElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether this Element is contained in the ownership tree of a library model.

inheritedAttributes.name: isOrdered
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether an order exists for the values of this Feature or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isPortion
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the values of this Feature are contained in the space and time of instances of the domain of the Feature and represent the same thing as those instances.

inheritedAttributes.name: isSufficient
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether all things that meet the classification conditions of this Type must be classified by the Type.(A Type gives conditions that must be met by whatever it classifies, but when isSufficient is false, things may meet those conditions but still not be classified by the Type. For example, a Type Car that is not sufficient could require everything it classifies to have four wheels, but not all four wheeled things would classify as cars. However, if the Type Car were sufficient, it would classify all four-wheeled things.)

inheritedAttributes.name: isUnique
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether or not values for this Feature must have no duplicates or not.

inheritedAttributes.name: isVariable
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Whether the value of this Feature might vary over time. That is, whether the Feature may have a different value for each snapshot of an owningType that is an Occurrence.

inheritedAttributes.name: member
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The set of all member Elements of this Namespace, which are the memberElements of all memberships of the Namespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: membership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All Memberships in this Namespace, including (at least) the union of ownedMemberships and importedMemberships.

inheritedAttributes.name: multiplicity
inheritedAttributes.documentation: An ownedMember of this Type that is a Multiplicity, which constraints the cardinality of the Type. If there is no such ownedMember, then the cardinality of this Type is constrained by all the Multiplicity constraints applicable to any direct supertypes.

inheritedAttributes.name: name
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a name even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: output
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All features related to this Type by FeatureMemberships that have direction out or inout.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedAnnotation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Element that are Annotations, for which this Element is the annotatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedConjugator
inheritedAttributes.documentation: A Conjugation owned by this Type for which the Type is the originalType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedCrossSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a CrossSubsetting}, for which the Feature is the crossingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDifferencing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Differencings, having this Type as their typeDifferenced.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedDisjoining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Disjoinings, for which the Type is the typeDisjoined Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedElement
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Elements owned by this Element, derived as the ownedRelatedElements of the ownedRelationships of this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedEndFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: All endFeatures of this Type that are ownedFeatures.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeature
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberFeatures of the ownedFeatureMemberships of this Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureChaining
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are FeatureChainings, for which the Feature will be the featureChained.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureInverting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are FeatureInvertings and for which the Feature is the featureInverted.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedFeatureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedMemberships of this Type that are FeatureMemberships, for which the Type is the owningType. Each such FeatureMembership identifies an ownedFeature of the Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedImport
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Imports, for which the Namespace is the importOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedIntersecting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Intersectings, have the Type as their typeIntersected.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMember

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Namespace that are Memberships, for which the Namespace is the membershipOwningNamespace.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRedefinition
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSubsettings of this Feature that are Redefinitions, for which the Feature is the redefiningFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedReferenceSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The one ownedSubsetting of this Feature, if any, that is a ReferenceSubsetting, for which the Feature is the referencingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationships for which this Element is the owningRelatedElement.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSpecialization
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Specializations, for which the Type is the specific Type.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedSubsetting
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSpecializations of this Feature that are Subsettings, for which the Feature is the subsettingFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTypeFeaturing
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Feature that are TypeFeaturings and for which the Feature is the featureOfType.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedTyping
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedSpecializations of this Feature that are FeatureTypings, for which the Feature is the typedFeature.

inheritedAttributes.name: ownedUnioning
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The ownedRelationships of this Type that are Unionings, having the Type as their typeUnioned.

inheritedAttributes.name: owner
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owner of this Element, derived as the owningRelatedElement of the owningRelationship of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningFeatureMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The FeatureMembership that owns this Feature as an ownedMemberFeature, determining its owningType.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningMembership
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The owningRelationship of this Element, if that Relationship is a Membership.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningNamespace
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Namespace that owns this Element, which is the membershipOwningNamespace of the owningMembership of this Element, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningRelationship
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Relationship for which this Element is an ownedRelatedElement, if any.

inheritedAttributes.name: owningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The Type that is the owningType of the owningFeatureMembership of this Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: qualifiedName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The full ownership-qualified name of this Element, represented in a form that is valid according to the KerML textual concrete syntax for qualified names (including use of unrestricted name notation and escaped characters, as necessary). The qualifiedName is null if this Element has no owningNamespace or if there is not a complete ownership chain of named Namespaces from a root Namespace to this Element. If the owningNamespace has other Elements with the same name as this one, then the qualifiedName is null for all such Elements other than the first.

inheritedAttributes.name: shortName
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The short name to be used for this Element during name resolution within its owningNamespace. This is derived using the effectiveShortName() operation. By default, it is the same as the declaredShortName, but this is overridden for certain kinds of Elements to compute a shortName even when the declaredName is null.

inheritedAttributes.name: textualRepresentation
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The TextualRepresentations that annotate this Element.

inheritedAttributes.name: type
inheritedAttributes.documentation: Types that restrict the values of this Feature, such that the values must be instances of all the types. The types of a Feature are derived from its typings and the types of its subsettings. If the Feature is chained, then the types of the last Feature in the chain are also types of the chained Feature.

inheritedAttributes.name: unioningType
inheritedAttributes.documentation: The interpretations of a Type with unioningTypes are asserted to be the same as those of all the unioningTypes together, which are the Types derived from the unioningType of the ownedUnionings of this Type. For example, a Classifier for people might be the union of Classifiers for all the sexes. Similarly, a feature for people's children might be the union of features dividing them in the same ways as people in general.

constraints.name: checkStepEnclosedPerformanceSpecialization
constraints.documentation: AStep whose owningType is a Behavior or another Step must directly or indirectly specialize the Step Performances::Performance::enclosedPerformance.
constraints.ocl:
owningType <> null and
    (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or
     owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step)) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Performances::Performance::enclosedPerformance')

constraints.name: checkStepOwnedPerformanceSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A composite Step whose owningType is a Structure or a Feature typed by a Structure must directly or indirectly specialize the Step Objects::Object::ownedPerformance.
constraints.ocl:
isComposite and owningType <> null and
(owningType.oclIsKindOf(Structure) or
 owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and
 owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->
    exists(oclIsKindOf(Structure)) implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Objects::Object::ownedPerformance')

constraints.name: checkStepSpecialization
constraints.documentation: A Step must directly or indirectly specialize the base Step Performances::performances from the Kernel Semantic Library.

constraints.name: checkStepSubperformanceSpecialization
constraints.documentation: AStep whose owningType is a Behavior or another Step, and which is composite, must directly or indirectly specialize the Step Performances::Performance::subperformance.
constraints.ocl:
owningType <> null and
    (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or
     owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step)) and
    self.isComposite implies
    specializesFromLibrary('Performances::Performance::subperformance')

constraints.name: deriveStepBehavior
constraints.documentation: The behaviors of a Step are all its types that are Behaviors.

classes.name: Structure
classes.documentation: A Structure is a Class of objects in the modeled universe that are primarily structural in nature. While such an object is not itself behavioral, it may be involved in and acted on by Behaviors, and it may be the performer of some of them.
